g.text: the change is invisible to a person but
Same network and patches as before (1 800 in-domain test patches). White-box attacks use the gradient of the loss with respect to the pixels; PGD = projected
gradient descent, step ε/4, random start. The adversarially trained network saw FGSM examples with ε = 0.03 (about 8 grey levels) during training.
